image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) with characteristic black and yellow spotted patterning is positioned on a forest floor covered in dry leaves, moss, and small stones. The salamander's body is elongated with visible limbs and a tail extending to the left. A semi-transparent green watermark text 'JUNGLE' is overlaid on the bottom center of the image.
